text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while I was doing desk work...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! P-P-Please help me...!
Opera O-san is... acting so weird...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu...! Where did that usual
smile of yours go...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, even from a distance, you can tell
something's definitely off...
choice_data_list: No way... Could she be feeling down...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Amidst the silent depths, the cold sky I behold,
A dawn star shines forth, like a valiant conqueror of old—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What could that mean...?
It's becoming even more of a mysteryyy..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! It's no use...!
I'm seeking tranquility, yet visions of my beautiful self
clad in ultramarine keep surfacing, and I can't help but smile...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I thought she went to change, but now she's making that grim face again...!
Uuuugh, Opera O-san...!
choice_data_list: ...Could it have something to do with that outfit?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, an outfit...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh? That voice... It is you, Doto! And Trainer, too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyauu! I-I'm so sorry!
For sneaking a peek without asking~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What is there to apologize for?
It is only natural to be drawn in.
Before this, my brand-new charm...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brought out by an outfit different from my usual one,
behold a new, unfamiliar side of me...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am beautiful when shining like the sun, of course... but aren't I just as gorgeous when serene, dignified, and full of traditional Japanese charm?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It is a deep ultramarine dawn!
A winter sky for the New Year...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The winter sky of the new year...? Th-That's so deep~! As expected of Opera O-san!
choice_data_list: So that's what was going on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“In other words, you're searching for a new side of yourself that suits your new outfit...?”
When I asked, she nodded.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're quick on the uptake, as expected of my Trainer!
Indeed, I have been searching for...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And the one who appeared right then was... Doto!
It was you! Ahh, this can't be a coincidence...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You are always clad in an air of blue...
Allow me to learn from that sorrow and dignified poise!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hae?! M-Me...?!
Awawa, I don't really get it,
but if I can be of help, I'd love to...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You'll help out too, won't you, Trainer-kun?
What do you think?
How should I learn from her...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Imitation, huh! I see,
we're starting with the movements, then!
With my acting skills, it'll be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...! How's that...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Hawawa! Um, well...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your melancholy expression... is it like this!?
Guh! Make it more wistful, more exquisite...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: More...! Bleuer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, TM Opera O seemed to have learned something from Meisho Doto's movements...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, I want to see you being more natural.
Your everyday side profile, full of dignified melancholy...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Be natural... So I just need to act normal, right?
W-W-Understood~...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Thank you for your cooperation.
I shall choose another day to observe from the shadows, like a phantom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day... I spotted T.M. Opera O secretly (?) watching Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I am the Phantom of the Supreme Throne...!
Disguised as an angel, I gaze upon you in secret...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh, again...!?
I-If you stare at me like that, I can't keep calm—!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Uhyaah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Are you alright!?
Ah, it looks like you're unhurt...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that fall just now... that scream...
Simply marvelous! It serves as fantastic reference...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'm starting to feel seriously embarrassed now, aaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's useless...!
You cannot escape from a phantom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Meisho Doto was followed around
for several days...
